newsitem.title: INDIA: India Unicorp, Boart Longyear in tie-up.
newsitem.headline: India Unicorp, Boart Longyear in tie-up.

text.p: South Africa's Boart Longyear Group, a unit of Anglo-American Industrial Corp, will set up a venture with India's Unicorp Industries to make mining equipment in India, the two firms said in a statement on Monday.
Boart Longyear will hold 51 percent and Unicorp 49 percent in the new company to be called Boart Longyear Unicorp Ltd, the statement said.
No other financial details were available. A joint news conference has been scheduled for Wednesday, a spokeswoman for Unicorp told Reuters.
The statement said the new company planned to set up a unit near Delhi to manufacture capital equipment, rock drilling tools and certain diamond products.
The unit would cater to local demand and export selected products to South Africa to meet the global demand, the statement said.

Earlier, in July 1995, the two companies had forged a marketing alliance to sell Boart equipment used in mining of metals, coal, granite and marble as well as in infrastructure sectors like power and roads.
"This joint venture is a culmination of the strategic alliance entered into by the two companies in July 1995," the statement said.
India opened its mining equipment industry to foreign firms under an economic reform programme launched in 1991.
The Boart Longyear Group is one of the world's leading manufacturers and suppliers of tools, equipment and services to the international mining, quarrying and construction markets.
Unicorp Industries is a part of India's Sogani group of Industries which has been in the mining and construction business for more than three decades, the statement said.
